reviews.text: I’ve owned every iteration of the Nike Pegasus line for the last 10 years and they have been comfortable, dependable, and versatile. reviews.text:
This is a really good Pegasus. I’ve ran in versions 37, 38, 39, 40, and now 41, and I have to say this is the best one yet for what it is - a mileage workhorse. This is not the fastest shoe in the market, not the most cushioned shoe in the market, nor the most supportive. However, it is responsive, relatively lightweight, and stable enough to allow you to show up and log mile after mile after mile without it feeling like a chore. Especially with the new wider toe box, this really is now the shoe for those 30 to 90 minute every day runs that allow you to build your fitness from the ground up day after day. Perfect for easy runs with strides, medium long runs, and maybe a little bit of uptempo if you’re feeling good that day. Also great for doing warmups, drills, cooldowns, and light gym work.

The only downside with this shoe is that, compared to Pegasus of the past, working out in this shoe does leave a lot to be desired. But then again, it got a lot better at long runs and recovery runs, which suggests that this really is that mileage shoe with a classic feeling for every day runs when you don’t want to overdo it.

If you don’t like ground feel and you prefer a more cruise-y / rockered ride, then I would look at the Vomero instead. And if you need a faster shoe, I would look at the Zoom Fly, Vaporfly, or Alphafly depending on your budget and your needs.
reviews.title: The heart of the classic nike rotation

reviews.text:
Recently purchased the Pegasus 41 for casual running and a comfortable pair of shoes to walk around in. The Pegasus 41 definitely meets these two requirements for me. The running experience is grounded and natural, it's not overly cushiony which lets you get some speed but if you want a plush, cushioned ride you might want to get something else. For walking it's perfect, my feet don't hurt or feel sore, I even wore it for about 10 hours (seated, standing, walking) and did not feel like I needed to take them off because of soreness or overheating.

Would definitely recommend if you don't need a super soft feel but prefer something more natural and stable.
reviews.title: All round running shoe
